name: ELIX Devices
description: Hardware control hub for Bluetooth, Wi-Fi, multi-display monitors, audio mixers, and battery diagnostics on ELIX OS

scan_bluetooth_devices.name: scan_bluetooth_devices
scan_bluetooth_devices.description: Discover nearby Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) and classic peripherals with RSSI signal indicators

toggle_bluetooth_state.name: toggle_bluetooth_state
toggle_bluetooth_state.description: Enable/disable Bluetooth radio or connect, disconnect, pair, or unpair target devices

scan_wifi_networks.name: scan_wifi_networks
scan_wifi_networks.description: Scan for surrounding Wi-Fi access points with SSID, channel, security type (WPA3/WPA2), and signal strength

configure_display.name: configure_display
configure_display.description: Configure screen resolution, refresh rate, UI scale factor, and orientation for target display

set_audio_device.name: set_audio_device

get_battery_diagnostics.name: get_battery_diagnostics
get_battery_diagnostics.description: Query power status, charging state, cycle counts, battery health percentage, and estimated runtime

list_connected_peripherals.name: list_connected_peripherals
